FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Backend Cleanup
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A few minor bits of code cleanup.

patchNoteLines.li: Small change to the location text translation key for settlements
Update costs and build times for the orbital settlement types
Add mod settings for previously un-tweakable values

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Backend Updates
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A handful of backend updates to help cleanup the code a bit.

patchNoteLines.li: Backend code updates. User-facing behavior should not change.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Production Rework
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Reworks how resource production is calculated and displayed. All values are now calculated in per-day increments, added up each day before being disbursed on the tax tick. The net income should be the same, but the affect of mid-cycle production differences should be more obvious than the old average-of-daily-snapshots system.\n\nAlso, tithing has been slightly reworked. The tithes list is now a priority list of items. You can list more items than your settlement can afford, and when the tax tick comes, you will be sent the first N items that fit within the tithe limit.

patchNoteLines.li: Resource production rework: all values are calculated on a daily basis. The length of the tax cycle merely determines how frequently acrued production is sent to the player
Minor tithes rework: the tithe item list is now a priority list, sending the first N items that fit within the tithe budget

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: New Feature: Situations
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds Situations, shamelessly stolen from - er, inspired by - Stellaris. Situations feature a meter that can tick up or down over time, as well as the opportunity for the player to pick one of several 'approaches' to influence how the Situation resolves.\n\nThis initial implementation is a rough first pass. It needs further UI work, and to also be more featureful in general (not to mention it needs actual Situations to be used with).

patchNoteLines.li: First implementation of Situations

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Fixes & Features
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A variety of minor bugfixes, changes, and features.

patchNoteLines.li: When a settlement defends itself in a manual defense battle without an assigned squad, its defenders are assembled from the player's unit designs
Food resource is now Farming, and features all resources that can be harvested from plants (except for medicine and drugs, which continue to belong to the Medicine resource (except for beer))
The Mining resource now only allows rock types belonging to the settlement's tile. Obsidian is only titheable in the Lava Field biome
Add difficulty settings for global worker base production and worker production multipliers. Higher difficulties have a harsh multiplier; lower difficulties are now swimming in resources
Allow more than one event window to be open at a time
When the player defeats an NPC settlement through a normal vanilla attack, they are now given the option to capture the settlement for their empire

When generating a manual defense battle map, all turrets are stripped if the player doesn't have the tech for them. This was unnecessary for Empire itself, but *is* necessary when using other mods for base gen, such as Vanilla Base Generation Expanded
In manual defense battles, civilian pawns' names are rendered in a muted color compared to the defender pawns, making them easier to tell apart
Bugfix: the "Settlement Formed" letter that's sent after capturing an enemy settlement would not report the correct name

Leathers that do not come directly from an animal (e.g. patchleather) are moved from the Animals resource to the Apparel resource. In theory, this should provide compatibility with Vanilla Factions Expanded: Midieval 2 as well
Add a mod setting to let the player control how frequently (or infrequently) their roads build
Adds updated Spanish translation

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Hired Laborers!
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds the ability to hire laborers, mimicing the system used by the Royalty DLC's Call Laborers permit. As this mimics a Royalty feature, it is locked behind access to the Royalty DLC, per Ludeon's modding policy.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds the ability for the player to periodically hire laborers from the Empire faction, with several configuration options in the mod settings

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Manual Offense Battles
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds manual offense battles! With this, you should now be able to run all Empire battles manually!

patchNoteLines.li: Adds Manual Offense battles (e.g. raid, capture, enslave). Offense battles have their own auto-vs-manual toggle in the settings, independent of defense battles
Adds a Raze attack type, the sole objective of which is to destroy the target settlement. Only available to Militaristic, Isolationist, or Authortarian empires
Barracks changed: it is more expensive to build and upkeep, but now grants +1 squad slot to its settlement
Add mod settings to let the user add additional military levels to npc factions, for added difficulty
Add mod setting to let the user control the military level -> raid points conversion

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Performance and Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A handful of small fixes and performance improvements.

patchNoteLines.li: Fixes some issues with rendering settlement stat modifiers
Updates the message that appears when checking the Empire faction tech level to be aware of the "mirror player faction tech level" setting
Minor perf-related changes to the Codex and a couple of harmony patches on hot paths

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Bugfixes Galore
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Numerous fixes for features new and old.

patchNoteLines.li: Numerous manual offense bugfixes
Bugfix: when loading a post-squad-refactor save with deployed merc squads, their lord, map, and order would be clobbered by default values
Bugfix: on-disk custom xenotypes could be wiped from the xenotype filter when loading a save

Bugfix: non-settlement objects that participate in Empire's raid system (such as Vanilla Outposts Expanded outposts when using the Outposts & Settlements submod) would not correctly resolve their post-battle events, and would permanently become un-choosable for further raids

Bugfix: when viewing a building after selecting the slot that it's currently in, the UI would show both a "Demolish" and a "Destroy" button, with the latter having almost none of the protections of the former
Bugfix: rolled-over random-tithe stock is paid out twice due to never actually being subtracted from the original budget
Bugfix: settlements use the faction name generator instead of the settlement generator
Bugfix: caravan deliveries with more than 100 items would silently lose everything past the 100th
Bugfix: merc gear quality would shift as a result of combat efficiency. Now that players can set their gear quality directly, this feature is defunct
Bugfix: some cooldowns were saved incorrectly, resulting in them never firing a letter on cooldown completion after saving and loading the game
Bugfix: the founding date for both the faction and settlements was calculated incorrectly
Bugfix: gravship launches could improperly destroy the capital spot
Bugfix: settlement levels were improperly capped, resulting in them clamping to the global cap instead of the minimum of the global cap and the settlement type cap
Bugfix: the weighting of pawn options derived from the xenotype filter was calculated incorrectly
Bugfix: the "starting" lat/long was overwritten on every game load
Bugfix: the inventory and apparel sections in the unit designer would only consider thingdef and count when it comes to equality, ignoring stuff and quality
Bugfix: an overly terse patch on Notify_MemberDied would skip ideo and faction leader death handling
Bugfix: delivery pawns would lose their lord info across a save and load
Bugfix: when processing a defense battle loss, we would only check the first 4 buldings for destruction instead of all of them
Bugfix: faction-wide events could apply their penalties to settlements that didn't exist when the event first fired
Bugfix: edict activation wouldn't properly rebuild their action gates
Remove the now-outdated "Reset All Military Squad Assignments" debug action
Bugfix: the computation for if a shuttle or other skyfaller would fit in a space could return true when it shouldn't
Bugfix: rewire the stat modifier descriptions for squadCapPerSettlement and maxSquadSize to match how other stat modifiers are printed in the UI
Update the buttons used for rearranging tithe priority in the settlement window
Performance: use caching and viewport culling to improve performance of the unit designer

Bugfix: if an external auto-defender is assigned to a settlement under attack, and the militayr op is torn down without going through the battle path (e.g. by removing the settlement outright), then the external auto-defender would never be alerted that they can stand down

Alter several stats to actually apply to the settlement scope: military level bonus (defending), military efficiency bonus (defending), battle prosperity/happiness/loyalty loss multiplier, building destruction chance, flat tax bonus, research contribution multiplier, extra workers softcap, over-max workers adjustment
Bugfix: events that open with options wouldn't actually increase their fire count, meaning that events that are supposed to happen only once or twice could actually happen endlessly
Bugfix: some events would show up in the mod settings disablement window when they aren't supposed to

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Manual Offense Bugfix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a bug with manual offense battles.

patchNoteLines.li: During a manual offense battle that the player has reinforced with their own pawns, in the period between vanilla thinking that the battle is over and Empire thinking that the battle is over, the player could Reform Caravan to take draft Empire mercs out of the map. They'd be culled a second later due to not being world pawns, so the exploit potential is minimal; but the player should not be able to form a caravan with empire pawns in the first place

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: More Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Final wave of fixes before the workshop release of Empire Refactored 1.6.

patchNoteLines.li: Update tooltips in the production area of the settlement window
Update the tithing UI and tooltips to better explain how tithing works with the new daily cadence
Bugfix: settlements founded in the middle of a tax cycle would show an incorrect 'days til tax' estimate
Spelling and grammar fixes in user-facing text

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Fix & Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: An events bugfix and minor tweak.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: random events could fire more frequently than the min/max days per random event setting should allow
Max radius for fire support changed to 100 (was 30)
